title: Preliminary stratigraphic database for the subsurface Tertiary and uppermost Cretaceous sediments of Dorchester County, South Carolina
citation: Gohn, G.S., Bybell, P.G., Chirico, R.A., Christopher, R.A., Edwards, L.E., Frederiksen, N.O., Prowell, D.C., Self-Trail, J.M., and Weems, R.E., 2000, Preliminary stratigraphic database for the subsurface Tertiary and uppermost Cretaceous sediments of Dorchester County, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-2000-49.
notes:
Chapter C (drill-hole data charts). The packet text holds only the correlation chart, references, index map and paleontologic occurrence tables; the field logs and geosummary logs (pages 6-7 etc.) have no text in the packet, so no lithologic intervals could be read. Correlation-chart ages are inferred from chart position (chart text is jumbled). Species occurrence rows were not transcribed. Table depths are sampling depths; the source says to add 5 feet to convert to log depths. Clubhouse Crossroads Tertiary nannofossil zones (page 9) were not assigned to formations because column alignment is ambiguous. No locations are given in the text.
Packet holds only paleontologic occurrence tables (Clubhouse Crossroads sporomorphs, Pregnall nannofossils, dinocysts and sporomorphs, St. George Cretaceous and Tertiary nannofossils, DOR-St2 nannofossils). Species rows were not transcribed; the Pregnall dinocyst table depths are printed as ## in the text. Zone-to-formation assignments are inferred from header order. Peedee/Donoho Creek stages on page 21 repeat those on page 8 (packet 1) and were not recorded again. Logs on pages 12-15, 19-20, 23-26 have no text in the packets.
